venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 2/27.** Garden: opened 5:30, good weather drove traffic, several larger parties, manageable waitlist; Ian held it down solo with support from Grant, Sophia, Josh and the MOD; wrapped a little after 12:30am. D&C: bar top filled quickly at open, room fully sat by 7, very few lulls, bar busy through ~12:30. Kitchen: 11.88% of sales; MOD stepped in as kitchen coverage and James came in during the rush on dish; Chips and Dip, Fried Chicken, Bread & Butter and Tuna Crudo were hits. MOD: Cory / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 2/27.** Smooth night; slow first and last turns with some waitlist in the middle turns; a few larger parties kept energy high; strong food sales kept check average high and offset the short guest count. Comps $89.36. Door: later start, 90% full at 7pm, waitlist built after 8 with a mix of large groups and twos, push at 10pm, waitlist died ~11:30, bar refilled before last call; guests from Spain including a local living across the street who had never visited; birthdays and anniversaries. No no-shows. Kitchen: 86 arancini.
